event: The fifth divergence: the Apex schematic's through-corridor east is a sealed wall.
Tomás reads the fresh pressure stress and calls the longer second route.
Dayo finds no seam or mechanism, turns, and takes point on the second route.
Tomás builds a corrected map beside the Apex schematic as they walk.
Three divergences are documented in detail and two flagged for later.
He stops at a wall section with a look of recognition, notes it, and goes on.
Solenne files his new signal under: the same hand.
They reach a natural widening; the route has cost twenty minutes.
Tomás wants the actual geometry ahead, not Apex's; Solenne names Cartographer's Truth.
Solenne commits thirty-five MP from her 290 without debate.
The skill fires through their overlap: Terrain Read and the Conductor together.
The true floor map fills in: fourteen rooms, nine cleared, five remaining.
It shows three Wardens ahead, one in the east branch, two traps, the rest node at eleven.
It reveals a locked door at the far east end, missing from Apex's documents.
The map is correct; Solenne feels its weight land and stay.
Then the skill goes deeper, and Solenne receives signal, not a map.
Six frequencies are embedded in the Tower's load-bearing structure.
Steadfast, Clearvoiced, Warmhearted, Openhanded, Brightspirit, Trueweave: designed, not ambient.
The skill fades after five minutes; Solenne holds what she received in silence.
Tomás is already writing; he received the architectural layer too.
Dayo holds her weapon ready; Vesper has frozen with her Workframe running hot.
Nadia is very still, her signal still sounding like a struck bell.
Tomás finishes his first notation pass; Solenne says she must tell them what she saw.
She describes the six frequencies in the load-bearing geometry, precisely.
The stone carries the signal literally, as a person carries an Aspect.
Something built the Tower knowing Harmony Aspects before the System named them.
She holds back her guesses about who built it and why.
Dayo asks if it changes the next encounter; Tomás says the enemies are still the enemies.
Dayo says they move when ready, holding the weight and stepping forward.
Miriam asks built by who; Solenne says the skill shows structure, not authorship.
Miriam opens her notebook to the main text and writes; Nadia watches her hands.
Vesper lays both palms flat on the wall, at two sections.
She says the Hollow Wardens' joint structure is the same construction.
Nadia asks what the Brightspirit frequency felt like.
Solenne: like a note someone has played in this room a very long time.
Nadia nods once: filed, she will hold it.
Miriam closes her notebook: not built knowing the System would exist; built expecting it.
Tomás reports the skill showed a locked door at the floor's far end.
Dayo asks what kind; Composite designation, like the Floor 17 Locked Room.
Solenne thinks of Vasic's paper and Six of Six in her queue, still unused.
Tomás gives her the information without telling her what to do; she nods.
Tomás says after the Hollow Wardens; Dayo confirms.
Dayo signals formation three with a gesture; the party assembles and moves.
Six people carry the same knowledge in six registers, forward through the floor.
The Conductor reads the ambient shift that comes before enemy contact.
Dayo adjusts her grip; Tomás closes his notation and clears his longbow.
Miriam carries her written question; Nadia's hand rests on the dulcimer case.
Vesper walks with empty hands, the Workframe running hot.
Behind them, the widening's Brightspirit layer keeps sounding.
Dayo rounds the corridor bend, and the Hollow Wardens turn.
